summary: You can act on many administrators at once and handle requests to enable admin accounts.

new.title: Act on many administrators at once
new.text: Select administrators to link them to a company or department, or queue a new Temporary Access Pass or a sign-out everywhere for each.

new.title: Access requests page (Pro)
new.text: Approve or deny requests to enable a disabled admin account for a set time, end a window early, or grant an IT override of up to 31 days.

new.title: Request portal for consultants (Pro)
new.text: Consultants sign in with a one-time PIN to ask for access, and ticketing systems can send requests too. Deploying the portal is a separate step.
